beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the Musinique mark. Four transforms this time: scale, rotation, skew, and a blur that fades in as it sharpens. Same rule as part one: no keyframes anywhere — every move is a function of the frame.
Your turn. Paste this: rotate my logo three hundred sixty degrees with a spring settle, then show the same spin with linear timing — and tell me why the spring reads better.
Musinique, in motion. Part two. Liam, in for Bear.
